Go from **pilots to production** in days without compromising trust, security, and sovereignty. Available for deployments across enterprises and AI Factories.

#### Industry-first turnkey Agentic AI platform, built on NVIDIA Confidential Computing

Build and run secure AI workloads on-premises, in the cloud, or in AI Factories with complete control over your data, models, and operations. Combine Confidential Computing with turnkey AI orchestration, backed by composite attestation and secure key release, to protect every stage of the AI pipeline. You now have a proven path to innovation with data and AI security, trust, and sovereignty at the core.

![Overview Diagram](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/platform/armet-ai/overview-diagram.png)

#### Security and Trust

Protect your business with a Trusted Execution Environment to isolate and process data and AI privately, thwarting unauthorized access.

- Cutting-Edge Hardware: Built on NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPUs and Intel SGX and TDX CPUs
- End-to-End Trust: Composite attestation for CPU and GPU with Fortanix Confidential Computing Manager and NVIDIA NRAS creates single chain of trust
- Secure Key Release: Fortanix Data Security Manager allows access to datasets and model artifacts only after verified attestation
- Confidential AI: Enable secure AI fine-tunning, training, and inference without exposing raw data or models
- Block Malicious Tampering: AI Guardrails protect from insider and outside threat by reducing the blast radius and continuously monitor model outputs

![Security and Trust Without Compromise](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fplatform%2Farmet-ai%2F1-1-feature-02.webp&w=3840&q=75)

#### Sovereignty and Compliance

Drive regulatory compliance, maintain sovereignty, and enable frictionless audits

- Consistent RBAC: Apply source-level Role-Based Access Controls directly into projects for granular permissions
- Universal Policy Enforcement: Ensure consistent controls​ and governance across the complete AI pipeline
- Deployment Options: On-premises for mission-critical or sovereign projects, in the Cloud (Google, Azure), or in Enterprise AI factories
- Next-gen HSM with built-in KMS: FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certified, strict key custody, Zero Trust architecture, and immutable audit logs
- End-To-End Data Security: Protect data at all data stages—at rest, in transit, and in use

![Sovereignty and Compliance by Design](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fplatform%2Farmet-ai%2F1-1-feature-03.webp&w=3840&q=75)

#### Speed and Agility

Go from pilots to production in days with turnkey solution

- Complete Agentic AI Platform: Customizable, with built-in AI guardrails, observability, and orchestration
- Enterprise Data Connectors: Integrate seamlessly with major enterprise applications
- API-First Architecture: Support automation and build tailored AI solutions leveraging rich API capabilities
